# nagios_nna_source (Resource)

Manages a Nagios Network Analyzer flow data source (a NetFlow/sFlow/jFlow listener).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nagios_nna_source" "example" {
  name        = "core-switch-netflow"
  port        = 9995
  flowtype    = "netflow"
  lifetime    = "30"
  description = "NetFlow export from the core switch"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A human-readable description of this source.
- `flowtype` (String) The flow protocol this source collects. One of "netflow", "sflow", or "jflow".
- `lifetime` (String) The number of days of flow data to retain, as a string (e.g. "30") - Network Analyzer's API rejects this as a JSON number despite it representing a day count.
- `name` (String) The name of this source. Must be unique across all sources.
- `port` (Number) The UDP port this source listens on for incoming flow data. Must be unique across all sources.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this source is actively collecting flow data. A newly created source always starts active; set to false to stop it.

### Read-Only

- `directory` (String) The server-assigned directory this source's flow data is stored under.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID Network Analyzer assigns this source. Unlike this provider's XI resources, Network Analyzer addresses objects by ID rather than name.
